description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'AcknowledgementCorrelationIdMissingException', used in the context of acknowledgements within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It indicates that an acknowledgement was missing a 'correlation-id' header, preventing forward to the original requester. The class includes builder patterns, JSON parsing, and integration with Ditto-specific headers and exceptions.

classes.name: AcknowledgementCorrelationIdMissingException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that a mandatory 'correlation-id' header was missing from an acknowledgement in Ditto.

classes.description: A builder class for fluent creation of 'AcknowledgementCorrelationIdMissingException' instances.
